column1: # Indonesian glossary. Claude-only proposal, drafted 2026-11-05 alone by Claude, pending the three-vendor debate; not final.

# Same columns as en.tsv: term holds the Indonesian, forms separated by " | ". Indonesian has no gender or number, and the matcher does not inflect it, so affixed and pe(N)-...-an forms are listed. Definitions are D3's where D3 changed them.

# Rows D3 retires stay, mapped to the chosen term, until D3 merges and en.tsv drops them. acceleration-eco and acceleration-turbo become do-not-translate at D3 and lose their rows then. D3's new rows and renamed ids wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/id.tsv.

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows below already use D3's. Following those rows now would call the setting Kecepatan tertinggi and the measured value Kecepatan maksimum, the swap section 7 of the style guide forbids.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), and main_speed_* if they arrive first. They stay English (council verdict fallback). pack.py has no per-key filter, so a run over those areas must rule them out by hand. Other keys with these terms already match D3.
